knownDefects.summary: No LICENSE file exists upstream. LICENSE and LICENSE.md both return HTTP 404, and the GitHub API reports license: null. Redistribution rights are therefore unstated — the default is exclusive copyright, so redistribution is not granted. Vendored for internal reference only; treat as do-not-redistribute until upstream adds a license.
knownDefects.status: unpatched — cannot be fixed locally. Documented, not fixed.

knownDefects.summary: Substantially overlaps the Ponytail, Grill-me and Clean-code-guard modes already active in AGENTS.md, which were written independently and cover the same four behaviours. Two principles overlap only partially: 'Goal-Driven Execution' asks for a written verify step per plan item, and 'Surgical Changes' states the trace test (every changed line traces to the request) — neither is spelled out in the existing modes. Enabling both is deliberate, per user direction, not an oversight. Duplication is accepted and documented in PROVENANCE.md.
